questionText:

Crude petroleum consists of hydrocarbons of liquid and gaseous states
varying in chemical composition, colour and specific gravity. It is an
essential source of energy for all internal combustion engines in
automobiles, railways and aircraft. Its numerous by-products are
processed in petrochemical industries, such as fertiliser, synthetic rubber,
synthetic fibre, medicines, vaseline, lubricants, wax, soap and cosmetics.
Crude petroleum occurs in sedimentary rocks of the tertiary period. Oil
exploration and production was systematically taken up after the Oil and
Natural Gas Commission was set up in 1956. Till then, Digboi in Assam was
the only oil producing region, but the scenario changed after 1956. In
recent years, new oil deposits have been found at the extreme western and
eastern parts of the country. In Assam, Digboi, Naharkatiya and Moran are
important oil producing areas. The major oilfields of Gujarat are
Ankaleshwar, Kalol, Mehsana, Nawagam, Kosamba and Lunej. Mumbai

High, which lies 160 km off Mumbai, was discovered in 1973 and
production commenced in 1976. Oil and natural gas have been found in
exploratory wells in the Krishna-Godavari and Kaveri basin on the East

cannot be used directly. It needs to be refined. There are two types of
refineries in India: (a) field-based and (b) market-based. Digboi is an
example of field based and Barauni is an example of market based refinery.

questionText: Which of the following statements is NOT correct regarding Site Factors (Human Geography - Nature and Scope)?

options.text: Wet-point settlements locate near water sources (springs, rivers) in dry regions; Dry-point settlements locate on upland knolls to avoid floods in wet regions
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies the incorrect statement regarding Site Factors.

options.text: Both terms are identical and mean underground sewer networks
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Selected a factually correct statement instead of identifying the exception.

options.text: Wet-point settlements are exclusively marine harbors, while dry-point are coal mines
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Failed to distinguish valid properties from the invalid exception.

options.text: Wet-point settlements are located inside swimming pools, while dry-point are in bakeries
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Overlooked the 'NOT' constraint in the question stem.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
In Human Geography - Nature and Scope (Site Factors):
The statement 'Wet-point settlements locate near water sources (springs, rivers) in dry regions; Dry-point settlements locate on upland knolls to avoid floods in wet regions' is incorrect (and hence the correct answer to the exception question).
All other statements represent valid NCERT characteristics.

Therefore, option (A) is the correct choice.
